scope: Experimental direct versus log-spherical trilinear force grid.
statistics_scope: Force comparisons only in this phase.
timing_scope: Synchronized force batch and sequential scan timings for 2048 identical off-node requests; first calls include any compilation. Grid lowering/compilation, first construction and one warm rebuild are separate; table I/O and statistics are excluded.
force_probe_scope: 4096 uniform log-radius/polar-angle/azimuth draws in all octants, plus 61 radii on nine axes/planes/diagonal/near-axis directions. The deterministic probes are shared across all resolutions.
physical_energy: Unchanged direct potential, not an interpolated scalar.
